title: Review queue: detect and review external blocks/mutes
description: 8-phase feature: detect blocks/mutes created outside ErgoBlock (e.g., via Bluesky mobile app) and surface them for review. Users can assign durations, mark permanent, or dismiss. Includes card view (one-at-a-time), table view (bulk ops), empty states, and integration tests. Full implementation plan: docs/implementation-plans/2026-01-29-review-queue/ (phases 1-8). Phase 1: type definitions. Phase 2: sync detection + message handlers. Phase 3: signals. Phase 4: card view UI. Phase 5: table view + bulk ops. Phase 6: manager tab integration. Phase 7: empty states. Phase 8: integration tests.
close_reason: All 8 phases implemented: type definitions, sync detection, signals, card view, table view, manager integration, empty states, 16 tests. 511 tests passing.

title: Background.ts decomposition: extract domain services
description: Extract domain services from the 4,763-line background.ts one at a time: blocking first (most self-contained), then muting, then expiration, then audit. Background.ts becomes a ~60-line entrypoint that registers message handlers. Each domain exports a Handler[] array. The background worker is a message router, not a logic container. Estimated: 2 sessions. Risk: Medium. Shippable alone: Yes (incremental). Ref: docs/clean-slate-review-2026-02-09.md step 4.
close_reason: background.ts reduced from 516 to 283 lines. All inline handlers extracted to domain modules: bg/mass-ops.ts (settings/cluster), bg/car-handlers.ts, bg/clearsky-handlers.ts, bg/graph-ops.ts (profiles), bg/init.ts (initialization/migrations), bg/import-export.ts. 495 tests passing.
